answer.likely_cause: The Northgate Expenses app is experiencing a redirect loop due to missing or incorrect `X-Forwarded-Proto` headers.

evidence.line: 2026-10-26 22:12:44,141 INFO oidc-rp event=force_https path=/ scheme=http x_forwarded_proto=-
evidence.why: The app is forcing HTTPS but is receiving an HTTP request, indicated by `scheme=http` and `x_forwarded_proto=-`.

evidence.line: 172.30.182.10 - - [26/Oct/2026:22:12:45 +0000] "GET / HTTP/1.1" 302 235 "-" "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/153.0.8010.12 Safari/537.36"
evidence.why: The app is responding with a 302 redirect, indicating a loop.

fix_steps: Check the nginx configuration for the location block serving the Northgate Expenses app.
Ensure that the `proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme` directive is present and correctly configured.
If necessary, add the missing `proxy_set_header` directives to the location block.
Run `nginx -t` to test the configuration and `nginx -s reload` to apply the changes.
answer.customer_reply: We have identified that the Northgate Expenses app is experiencing a redirect loop due to missing or incorrect headers. We are working to correct the configuration and will update you shortly.
